title: WoW: Forever Class Design, Echoes of the Worldcore, and More in WoW Weekly
author: Blizzard Entertainment

short_news.title_en: WoW: Forever Class Design, Echoes of the Worldcore, and More in WoW Weekly

path: WoW: Forever Podcast – Catching up on Classes
changes.text: Join WoW: Forever Podcast host Countdown To Classic for a conversation with Senior Game Designer Aidan Moon and Principal Game Designer Kris Zierhut as they take careful aim on class design.

path: WoW: Forever Podcast – Catching up on Classes
changes.text: Watch now to bring class design into focus.

path: Midnight: Echoes of the Worldcore Arrives on December 1
changes.text: Azeroth’s history is waiting beneath the Coreway. Return to Dornogal, face the Storyteller’s macabre tales in Talebound, and join Li Li Stormstout for a Lorewalk through the stories that shaped Azeroth in Midnight: Echoes of the Worldcore.

path: Midnight: Echoes of the Worldcore Arrives on December 1
changes.text: The Worldcore is calling, and we can't wait to meet you in Dornogal.

path: Join the World of Warcraft 22nd Anniversary Celebration
changes.text: When: November 17–December 8 Where: Caverns of Time in Tanaris

path: Join the World of Warcraft 22nd Anniversary Celebration
changes.text: Players receive an automatic 10% Experience and Reputation buff during the Anniversary Event. Grab the quest from any Holiday Celebrants and hitch a ride to the Caverns of Time through portals located in Orgrimmar and Stormwind.
